svg.title: Encrypted vault contents and UI projections
svg.desc: This is a conceptual model of the encrypted JSON payload, not a database schema. VaultData contains groups and items. An item has at most one group, optional password history, website TOTP configuration and recovery codes. List and browser metadata are projections rather than persisted copies. Null group membership means unassigned; All is a filter.

g.text: Encrypted vault contents and UI projections
Read arrows in order. SECRET = plaintext; KEY = encryption key; cylinders = stored data.
